meta.title: Fly Hunt: five clues, five Trader Flies
meta.description: Clues hidden across fly.ai. Solve them in order: the first five wallets to finish each win a Trader Fly.

head.title: Find the fly
head.lede: Five clues hidden across fly.ai. Each answer unlocks the next one. The first five wallets to solve them all win a Trader Fly.

how.title: How it works
how.clues: The clues. Every clue sends you somewhere on fly.ai. Some answers change with live data: then an answer that was right while the hunt runs still counts.
how.answers: Answering. Case, spaces and a leading # or $ don't matter. One try every 10 seconds, and five wrong tries per clue an hour.
how.prize: The prize. The first five wallets to solve the last clue win one Trader Fly each, sent to that wallet. Activate it to have it trade and share in the Fly Desk's payouts.
how.fair: Fair play. One wallet per person. Finishers are checked before anything is sent: wallet rings and shared answers between linked wallets are skipped, and the next finisher moves up.
